question: Do outcome-blind legal trajectories on movement-novel task2633 candidates activate any fixed-scale material channel, and how early is the first observed activation?
scope: Feasibility only: 16 frozen generated rules x four deterministic uniform-legal board-action trajectories x at most128 plies. Record complete histories and adapter material features. Do not call terminal/result/WDL methods, run search, build/update models, train, evaluate strength, or admit roots to a panel.
action_selection: At each ply, uniformly choose from sorted ACTION choices only using the trajectory's fixed RNG seed; skip declarations and never inspect outcomes, candidate WDL, search values or feature values when selecting.
stop_rule: Stop at128 plies, when no board ACTION is available, an explicit role stop, or the300-second hard cap. No retry/top-up; capped/truncated histories remain explicitly incomplete.
interpretation: Trajectory outcomes are unobserved and therefore unknown. Activation is descriptive feasibility evidence, not a frequency/generalization or strength estimate. Newly emitted histories are exposed and excluded from future evaluation pools.
